name: audit
description: One structure for every audit (UI/UX, security, performance, code health): a committed six-part report and local-only evidence. Visual evidence comes from the repo's own `make screenshots-audit` (visual-kit).

interface.shortDescription: One report structure for every audit, with local-only evidence
interface.longDescription: Run UI/UX, security, performance and code-health audits in one shared shape: a committed six-part report, evidence kept local, and visual evidence from the repo's own make screenshots-audit (visual-kit).
